log_md:
Rev A1 of `macpro62-backplane` (routed 2026-10-04). The BP lines in §3 now use these values. Per-order savings, q1 (2 boards) / q5 (5 boards):

| # | Change | Old | New | Saving q1 / q5 | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Stackup 6L JLC06161H-2116 → **4L JLC04161H-7628** (1.6 mm, ENIG; L1 RX / L2 GND / L3 TX + 3V3_SB plane / L4 GND+breakout; impedance L1 83.1 Ω, L3 86.4 Ω, USB 90 Ω) | fab $50–80 | $25–45 | $25–35 / $25–35 | done, DRC 0 |
| 2 | PCBA Standard → **Economic**, single-sided (all SMT on F; Micro-Fit THT) | $145–190 / $185–245 | $45–70 / $60–90 | ≈ $100–120 / $125–155 | done; confirm Economic accepts the Mini Cool Edge 224 + MCIO (pre-order parts, 0 LCSC stock) |
| 3 | INA228 (C2887910, $6.24–6.38, 0 stock) → **INA226** (C49851, $0.76, 38,645 stock) | | | ≈ $11 / $27 | **needs Aidan's approval** |
| 4 | M.2 2242 socket J7 + its switch/caps (Q3, Q4, R9, R10, C17, C18) **DNP** (footprints kept) | | | ≈ $3–5 / $6–12 (parts + 1–2 extended feeders) | **needs approval** (BIOS/OpenCore boot location) |
| 5 | USB FS series R 27 Ω (extended) → **33 Ω basic** (R33 line merged) | | | $1.53 / $1.53 (feeder fee) | **needs approval** |
| 6 | Power-block placeholders → 2 × TPS563201 buck + merged 3V3_SB rail; RP2350B MCU (cheapest MCU with enough GPIO) | | | in the component line | done |
| 7 | Gen5 redrivers (5 × DS320PR810) **removed from the A1 layout** (loss budget: Gen4 9.5–16.8 dB of 28 dB) | option ≈ $95–115/board | $0 | not in the baseline (avoided option) | done |

BP total: **q1 $285–450 → $145–230** (−$140–220); **q5 $450–750 → $260–395** (−$190–355); per machine (q5) $90–150 → $52–79.
If the board ever has to go back to 6 layers: + $25–35 per order (fab only; Economic PCBA still applies). Not needed: rev A1 routes on 4 layers with DRC 0 / 0 unconnected.

RP2350B GPIO re-assignment in rev A1 (pin swaps for routability) **needs a firmware pin-map update** before bring-up; flagged for Aidan's approval with the INA226, J7 DNP, BIOS/OpenCore location, R27→R33 and U1/Y1/U2 moves.
